cards.title: SQL Injection (SQLi)
cards.description_long: SQL Injection occurs when an attacker inserts malicious SQL code into input fields that interact with a database. This allows attackers to manipulate database queries to read, modify, or delete sensitive data.

main_commands.explanation: Makes the SQL query always true

main_commands.command: ' UNION SELECT username, password FROM users --

main_commands.explanation: Attempt to delete a database table
Used to test if injection is possible

activity: Use UNION queries to extract data
Understand how SQL comments work in payloads
Observe how input validation prevents injection

cards.title: NoSQL Injection (NoSQLi)
cards.description_long: NoSQL Injection targets databases like MongoDB, CouchDB, and Firebase. Attackers manipulate query objects or JSON input to bypass authentication or retrieve unauthorized data.

main_commands.explanation: Matches any value not equal to null
Matches values greater than empty string

activity: Observe query behavior with JSON injection
Understand how input sanitization prevents NoSQLi

cards.title: OS Command Injection
cards.description_long: OS Command Injection occurs when user input is passed to system shell commands without proper sanitization. Attackers can execute arbitrary commands on the host operating system.
activity: Learn how input validation prevents command injection
